set.body: Acceptance: one declarative CSV/TSV schema names delimiter, header, time, x, y, gaze validity, pupil, and optional marker columns with explicit units and native missing tokens; parsing returns RawRecording plus all line/field diagnostics, never throws or silently drops; validation converts good rows to Recording while retaining rejected rows, native metadata, source lines, frame/clock specs, sample origins, and a SHA-256 source digest; a checked real public or vendor-produced fixture includes malformed and missing rows; parser, line-number, unit, and dropped-row mutants fail on JVM and Scala.js.
set.title: Golden workflow: declarative real CSV import with accumulated diagnostics
